purpose: Add before/after writing revisions and publicly shared grant applications. Keep source registries, complete proposals, revision pairs and edit-intent annotations as distinct units.

repositories.scope: Official author code/data archive. Import nested dataset separately, distinguish human edit-intention annotations from automatic classifier labels and preserve train/dev/test.
Official author release of source sentences and four human revision references. Sentences and reference pairs are not people or complete applications.
Community-shared grant proposals with program metadata. Registry entries are URL discovery, not acquired proposal bodies; official source statement provides CC-BY sharing for uploaded proposals.
